interface.name: trames_native_wsi_v1

description.summary: connection capability for native Vulkan WSI

interface.description: Internal guest ICD/compositor protocol. Sending an anonymous shared file binds its retained native inode identity to this Wayland connection. A NativeCall carrying a descriptor for that same file can resolve only this connection's protocol objects. Byte contents, guest fd numbers, numeric object IDs alone and host pathnames confer no authority. Transparent relays forward the file with normal SCM_RIGHTS. The grant expires when this object or connection is destroyed.

request.name: authenticate

description.summary: bind a fresh shared file to this connection

request.description: Each object accepts one fresh file. Reusing a previously granted inode is a protocol error, including reuse through another connection.
